title: Local Robustness of Bound States in the Continuum through Scattering-Matrix Eigenvector Continuation
summary: We consider the diffraction of time-harmonic plane waves by a periodic structure, governed by the Helmholtz equation. Bound states in the continuum (BICs) are quasi-periodic fields that remain $L^{2}$-bounded over one period and occur at frequencies embedded in the continuous spectrum. Perturbations that break a BIC can lead to ultra-strong resonances, enabling various applications in photonics.
